description: Set or rotate the OAuth 2.0 client credentials for a connector. This is an upsert: if credentials already exist they are REPLACED and the connection is re-established. It cannot be used to remove credentials - the payload is required.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_upsert_connector_oauth
title: Set connector OAuth credentials
